import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    n = int(data[1])

    k = 0
    if w > 2:
        for i in range(21):
            k = i
            if w ** i > 10**9:
                break

    set_vals = set()
    if w > 2:
        pows = [w ** i for i in range(k + 1)]
        limit = 1 << (k + 1)
        for mask in range(limit):
            s = 0
            for i in range(k + 1):
                if mask & (1 << i):
                    s += pows[i]
            set_vals.add(s)

    bol = (w == 2)
    for i in set_vals:
        if i >= n and (i - n) in set_vals:
            bol = True
            break

    sys.stdout.write("YES\n" if bol else "NO\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
